Hexagram 61, Zhongfu: the character for trust is a bird sitting on an egg
Fu originally means to brood. Trust in the Yijing is never 'we agreed' — it is keeping something warm. And hanyin is not a flying bird; it is a chicken.
Hexagram 62, Xiaoguo: a bird has gone and its sound is still there
Guo means passing one inch too far, not committing a fault. And the top line says the film over your eye is self-inflicted.
Hexagram 63, Jiji: the first character is having finished a meal
Ji is a person who has eaten and turns to look back. Silk left lying becomes worn wadding, and nobody tore it.
Hexagram 64, Weiji: the last hexagram ends on a progress bar
Wei is not a refusal, it is 'not yet'. The small fox nearly across, the tail already wet, and the last sentence of the book is poured wine.
